{{Quote|Right now you need me more than I need this job.''"<br />"''I need you less than you might think. Certainly less than ''you'' need an Imperial pardon for that mess you left on Borkyne&mdash;|Grand Admiral Mitth'raw'nuruodo, posing as Jodo Cast, to Dagon Niriz|<ref name="AJ12">"[[Side Trip]]"</ref>}}
'''Borkyne''' was location that shared its name with the [[Borkyne system/Legends|Borkyne system]] of the [[Bes Ber Bikade sector/Legends|Bes Ber Bikade sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dagon Niriz]] claimed that [[Jodo Kast]] needed an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] pardon for a mess made on Borkyne.<ref name="AJ12" />
